_what: The second rack under the porch roof on the Green: the newest videos YouTube's search finds for cities and towns making room for green, refilled every morning by tools/pull-green-latest.py on the morning timer (tools/daily-green.sh) and drawn by tools/make-the-green.py --latest. Ryan Boren's brief, 2026-10-07: a rack for the latest videos from a YouTube search for cities and towns making room for green; green spaces, green building techniques, urban forests, urban farms and edibles, solarpunk, renewable energy. Nobody here watches these first, and the room says so.
_searches: One search per thing on Ryan's list, in his order. q is what is typed into YouTube's search, filtered to videos put up this week; has is the words a result's own title must carry, any one of them, before it is even asked about, because a search's results are full of things that only mention the words somewhere. The words were chosen on 2026-10-07 by reading what each search turned up: a bare search for edibles is mostly food, so that one asks for food forests and edible gardens; a bare search for renewable energy is mostly investors, so that one asks about communities. Change a search here, in Ryan's words where they will do.
_rules: What goes on the rack, all of it worked out by tools/pull-green-latest.py and refused otherwise by tools/make-the-green.py: a video put up in the last week, whose title carries its search's words, that plays here (not a door, not age-gated, not live, not gone), and that its own channel did not file under Gaming or Music, because a game called Solarpunk and a song are not places. One per channel and no title twice, because a channel that put up five in a morning, or a broadcast three stations carried, would otherwise be the rack. Each search takes a turn, newest first, until the rack holds twenty, and then the rack is shown newest first. A short is not told apart from a video: YouTube's search does not say which is which.
